Package com.lemarketjames.common.domain

Class StaffUserEntity

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.common.domain.StaffUserEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoginAccount
@Entity public class StaffUserEntity extends Object implements LoginAccount
Maps to the `staff_users` table (database/schema/010): an internal user with exactly one staff Role. Staff are not clients, so they have no trading account (contract C7).
